title: Member Leads » Edit Leads | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Member Leads » Edit Leads Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000069107 By default all sites come a two ways for the visitors and members to submit a lead - The Get Matched page/form and the Profile Contact forms. During this process the form submitter may accidentally select the wrong Sub Category or make a typo while filling out their information. At which point they may reach out to the site Admin through the Contact Us form about this error - with this functionality it is possible to go in and edit the lead information. How to Edit a Lead 1) Go to Leads » Manage Leads In this example, the visitor selected "6:00 AM" instead of "4:00 AM". 2) Inside the Actions drop-down, select " Edit Lead ": 3 ) This will open a popup with the Lead Form, now it is possible to change the information that was incorrectly submitted: The changes are immediately reflected: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
